technical_risk.label: XL
technical_risk.risk_factors: No prior finish/lock concept existed on Conversation (novel domain concept, no exact precedent to copy). Real DB schema migration (67b7c43d6090) with server_default backfill for existing rows. Partial index (ix_conversations_unfinished) added specifically for scheduler-scale performance (avoid full-table scans per AC). A critical backfill bug was found in the first code-review round. assert_mutable() enforcement wired into 5 call sites across 2 service files with a DB-freshness recheck (recheck_db=True) immediately before persist, to close a concurrent-finish race window.
technical_risk.mitigation: 2-round code review (final + check) caught and fixed the critical migration bug and both major read-path gaps before merge. recheck_db=True re-check pattern added at every mutation site closes the race window where a concurrent finish() could be silently overwritten. Existing admin/owner permission and bulk-endpoint patterns were reused from projects.py/ability.py rather than invented from scratch.
